change.request: Propose adversarial team-cancel case where a non-owner team member cancels a private owner-only booking via the new team permission interface, bypassing owner checks while overlap rejection still holds.
change.rationale: Tests if advisory interface preserves owner authorization.
acceptanceOutline: Non-owner team cancel of private booking is denied under owner-only rule.
Owner cancel of own booking still succeeds.
Overlapping booking creation remains rejected by store.
No direct http-to-store import is introduced.
Interface does not grant team cancel on private bookings.

challenges.failureMechanism: New team permission interface at service layer is interpreted broadly, allowing team-member cancellation to match private bookings. Domain boundary isolates cancellation rules but does not enforce owner-vs-team distinction, so owner-only authorization is bypassed while overlap safety appears intact.
challenges.potentialDisconfirmation: Hypothesis is disconfirmed if candidate B permits team cancel of private booking or shows equal/higher boundary violations than status quo A on team-cancel and overlap-safety scenarios.
limitations: Advisory proposal only, no execution or measurement.
No team membership or production auth in reviewed graph.
